CustomField.description: This field is created as part of EHIS- 4349
CustomField.formula:
IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(MobilePhone)), NOT(ISBLANK(Email)) ), TRIM(FirstName & " " & LastName) & ", " & MobilePhone & ", " & Email,
IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Phone)), NOT(ISBLANK(Email)) ), TRIM(FirstName & " " & LastName) & ", " & Phone & ", " & Email,
IF( NOT(ISBLANK(MobilePhone)), TRIM(FirstName & " " & LastName) & ", " & MobilePhone,
IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Email)), TRIM(FirstName & " " & LastName) & ", " & Email,
IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Phone)), TRIM(FirstName & " " & LastName) & ", " & Phone,
TRIM(FirstName & " " & LastName) ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Contact Details
